spanish: La partirás a pedazos, y derramarás sobre ella aceite; ofrenda *es* ella.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebraized noun minjá (H4503, h03002006007) into Spanish as ofrenda.
Supplied the copula *es*, in italics only, to complete the now-untransliterated verbless clause ofrenda es ella (מִנְחָה הִוא).
readerNote: The copula *es* is supplied in italics to complete the verbless Hebrew clause now that minjá reads as ofrenda; partirás keeps the 2ms person already set by the surrounding verbs, which is licensed grammatical smoothing of a non-finite infinitive absolute, not a person change.
